hibernate-mapping.query: SELECT r FROM org.bonitasoft.engine.core.delegation.model.SDelegationRule AS r WHERE r.delegatorId = :delegatorId
SELECT p.processName FROM org.bonitasoft.engine.core.delegation.model.SDelegationRuleProcess AS p WHERE p.delegationRuleId = :ruleId ORDER BY p.id

SELECT new map(p.delegationRuleId as ruleId, p.processName as processName) FROM org.bonitasoft.engine.core.delegation.model.SDelegationRuleProcess AS p WHERE p.delegationRuleId IN (:ruleIds) ORDER BY p.delegationRuleId, p.id
